patch.summary: HubSpot implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement HubSpot by mapping current crm workflows to HubSpot objects, confirming plan gates for custom fields (Starter (Smart CRM / Customer Platform), Professional (Smart CRM / Customer Platform), Enterprise (Smart CRM / Customer Platform)), email sequences (Starter (Smart CRM / Customer Platform), Professional (Smart CRM / Customer Platform), Enterprise (Smart CRM / Customer Platform)), workflow automation (Starter (Smart CRM / Customer Platform), Professional (Smart CRM / Customer Platform), Enterprise (Smart CRM / Customer Platform)), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Gmail, Slack) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: custom fields (Starter (Smart CRM / Customer Platform), Professional (Smart CRM / Customer Platform), Enterprise (Smart CRM / Customer Platform))
Integrate after: data quality pass on Gmail

blocks.heading: HubSpot day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat HubSpot setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management, lead management, pipeline management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves SMB and mid-market teams wanting free CRM now and room to expand into hubs later before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Gmail and Slack before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover custom fields (Starter (Smart CRM / Customer Platform), Professional (Smart CRM / Customer Platform), Enterprise (Smart CRM / Customer Platform))

Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Sales Hub Professional starts at list pricenth per seat on the Product & Services Catalog and the Sales product page (re-checked 2026-08-18). HubSpot’s Sales pricing page also shows list price billed annually vs list price monthly, plus required Professional onboarding (list price). Starter marketing prices show new-customer discounts (*).

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Full GTM stack (Marketing Hub, Service Hub, etc.) is sold as additional hubs with their own seat/contact pricing — not included in Free CRM alone.

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Administration and packaging complexity rise sharply once multiple Professional/Enterprise hubs and seat types (Core vs Sales seats) are combined.

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: HubSpot plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Free CRM
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Starter (Smart CRM / Customer Platform)
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: custom fields, email sequences, workflow automation · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Professional (Smart CRM / Customer Platform)
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: forecasting, lead scoring · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise (Smart CRM / Customer Platform)
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: sso, role permissions · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.title: Validate crm fit before a deep HubSpot rollout
blocks.body: If HubSpot fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft HubSpot object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate Pipedrive before sunk-cost expansion
